title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Who We Are

Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI-powered SaaS Company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data-driven energy-related decisions.

Ranked #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future

.

What We Do

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAITM Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data - such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

How We Do It

From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is advancing smart meter innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short-term load forecasting, grid analytics and time of use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAITM energy analytics provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

For more information, please visit-

Website: www.bidgely.com

Blog: bidgely.com/blog

How You Fit In

You will act as the GM of your problem space, balancing customer empathy, product excellence, and business impact. You are data-obsessed, have a bias-to-action, and fluent in transforming insights into scalable CX outcomes. Standout candidates will be AI-native—comfortable articulating an ML-powered alue proposition and using GenAI tools for speed and scale.

You will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, with responsibility for the end-to-end product lifecycle, from roadmap and design to launch and enablement.

What You’ll Do

* Own a customer problem area end‐to‐end: define the vision, strategy, metrics, and delivery to the market; shape a 6-12‐month roadmap.
* Discover & prioritize through market analysis, customer interviews, data mining, and experiment results.
* Write & drive clear PRDs/specs; partner with Design Team to deliver accessible, intuitive UX across channels.
* Collaborate with Engineering & Data Science to ship solutions incrementally, including data

integrations, data engines, multi-application channel UX

* Measure outcomes (adoption, CSAT/NPS, call deflection, savings, reliability SLOs); run A/B tests;
* Enable GTM with crisp positioning, packaging, and launch plans; support client success and pre‐sales narratives.
* Represent the product with utility clients, regulators, and internal execs; communicate trade‐offs & decisions in writing.

What Makes You Successful

* 4–7+ years in Product Management with SaaS + data/analytics; 2+ years owning a CX/engagement or data‐driven product.
* Strong technical fluency: read APIs, reason about data models, eventing, and privacy/consent implications. Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and non-technical customers alike.
* Proven strategy execution muscle: experience in shipping multi‐quarter roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable processes.
* Facility with experimentation and product analytics; comfort with funnels, cohorts, and AB testing.
* Excellent writing & stakeholder leadership; can align execs and clients around trade‐offs.
* Domain bonus: utilities/energy (DSM/DR, TOU rates, DER/EV/solar), CSR tooling, or regulated industries.

Nice to Have

* Experience with load disaggregation or energy analytics; GenAI applications in CX and internal tooling.
* Working with enterprise buyers, procurements, and security/compliance reviews.

Core Competencies

* Product Visionary – Connects customer needs, data insights, and business growth to a cohesive product direction.
* Bias for Action – Turns insights into results in days and weeks, not quarters.
* Data‐Driven Storyteller – Uses data and experimentation to inform judgment, trade‐offs, and

prioritization.

* Polished Communicator – Crafts clear narratives for executives, cross‐functional peers, and

customers.

* Hands‐On Technical Aptitude – Understands APIs, models, and AI tools; can prototype or debug to unblock progress.
* Customer‐Centric Leader – Demonstrates empathy for end users and utility partners alike.
* Team Leader – Builds collaboration, motivates cross‐functional teams, and raises the product bar.

Why Join Bidgely?

* Shape the future of clean energy. Your work will directly influence how millions of customers

experience, understand, and participate in the energy transition — from electrification and EVs to smarter home engagement.

* Build at scale, backed by real impact. Bidgely’s platform already analyzes billions of energy data points daily; you’ll lead initiatives that amplify that reach through data, AI, and design.
* Join a global, high-caliber team. Collaborate with passionate engineers, designers, data scientists, and utility innovators across Silicon Valley, India, and Europe — all driven by a shared mission to decarbonize intelligently.
* Thrive in a culture of ownership and innovation. Expect autonomy, transparency, and a bias for action — we value ideas over hierarchy and results over noise.
* Grow your craft and your career. With access to cutting-edge GenAI tools, continuous learning opportunities, and visible impact across markets, you’ll have the runway to evolve as a product leader and shape the next chapter of UtilityAITM.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely we’re on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. Here, we believe that celebrating the unique backgrounds, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes an impact not only for our company internally but also for our clients, customers and community. We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that the inclusive atmosphere we build together will enable every person to grow, contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on your skills, talent, and passion – not on your background, gender, race, age, or the quirky way you dance at office parties.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Agile Product Owner
job_description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of more than 90 software companies worldwide, Vista supports growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is helping its portfolio companies apply generative AI responsibly across products, operations, and decision-making. Vista also supports learning and development through portfolio-wide programs, leadership workshops, and AI initiatives.

About Amtech

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Execution

* Own or support the product backlog for automated scheduling applications and related labeling or corrugated ERP capabilities.
* Work with Product Managers and in-market product leadership to translate roadmap initiatives into epics, user stories, and actionable backlog items.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on customer needs, product direction, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and ensure items are ready for sprint planning.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan delivery across multiple sprints and longer-term initiatives.
* Maintain product artifacts and, at the Senior Product Owner level, review PDLC artifacts for completeness and quality.

Manufacturing and Customer Insight

* Engage with customers, customer support, implementation, and services teams to understand manufacturing workflows and scheduling challenges.
* Translate production scheduling and manufacturing requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Help resolve software defects and define customer-specific features in collaboration with product management.
* Ensure product decisions reflect customer needs and support broader product goals.

Agile Delivery and Coordination

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in or facilitate sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.
* Clarify requirements and help teams understand the intended product outcomes.
* At the Senior Product Owner level, coordinate and support product owners across the India-based labeling and corrugated teams, and help build shared practices through a community of practice.

Product Delivery and Continuous Improvement

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Provide product expertise to internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities and product-owner practices.

Skills and Qualifications

* **Product Owner II:** Typically 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar software product role.
* **Senior Product Owner:** Typically 7+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including experience coordinating or supporting other Product Owners.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining requirements.
* Experience with ERP systems and the ability to translate business needs into technical product specifications.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with distributed teams.

**Your Job**

As an **Associate Product Manager**, you will help grow the cable assembly business by managing existing business and advancing new Emerging and Focused Customer opportunities through product development and production launch. You will connect commercial, technical, and operational teams to develop profitable solutions, successfully launch programs, and drive long-term customer and business value.

**Our Team**

You will be part of the **CCS PSBU Product Management** team in Bangalore, working closely with Sales, Business Development, Engineering, Costing, Sourcing, Planning, Purchasing, NPD, and Operations. The team collaborates across functions to develop and launch profitable cable assembly solutions for customers.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Drive revenue, profitability, and market-share growth for the Emerging and Focused Customer cable assembly business.
* Manage new cable assembly opportunities through the middle and later stages of the product development process, from requirements validation and costing through qualification, production readiness, and launch.
* Lead costing, quotation, and profitable pricing activities while ensuring customer requirements, Bill of Materials (BOM), feasibility inputs, and commercial assumptions are complete and aligned.
* Develop and drive program plans covering scope, schedules, risks, milestones, and success criteria, and lead cross-functional teams in resolving barriers to execution.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Sourcing, Planning, Purchasing, NPD, and Operations to ensure manufacturing readiness and smooth production ramp-up.
* Build strong relationships with customers, Sales, and distribution partners while serving as a key interface for technical and commercial discussions.
* Drive profitability of existing business through cost-variance improvements, capacity planning, quality improvements, and targeted cost-reduction opportunities.
* Monitor program performance, customer commitments, opportunity conversion, and product-development milestones, ensuring accurate records and effective stakeholder communication.

  
**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
* **10+ years of experience in Sales & Marketing and/or Product Management within the electromechanical device industry.**
* Experience supporting **product costing, quotation, pricing, or commercial activities** for engineered products.
* Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, engineering, and manufacturing/operations teams.
* Fluent written and spoken English with proficiency in word processing, spreadsheets, and presentation applications.

  
**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Experience in the **cable assembly, connector, or interconnect industry**.
* Experience managing products or customer programs through **product development and production-launch lifecycles**.
* Experience with **SAP** or similar enterprise resource planning systems.
* Experience engaging customers and Sales teams in technical discussions related to cable assemblies.
* Demonstrated experience with cost reduction, profitability improvement, capacity planning, or manufacturing-readiness initiatives.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

**Who We Are**

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Meet the Team
  
  
Join the Webex CX Product Management team to help shape the capabilities of our new Dialog product for long-duration AI engagements that resolve customer needs. Translate customer evidence into priorities and requirements, and partner with engineering and others to deliver compelling customer experiences that power the future of CX.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  

* Deliver on the Dialog product direction and AI roadmap
* Execute on the near-term Dialog roadmap, aligned with broader strategy and a focused on a 6-12 month horizon.
* Translate customer needs, workflow problems, and technical constraints into clear product outcomes, requirements, and priorities.
* Set requirements and success measures for a harness that enables long-duration AI engagements to resolve customer needs; surface key dependencies.
* Guide Customer and Evidence-Based Decisions
* Synthesize customer, field, support, usage, quality, and market input to identify needs and guide product decisions.
* Validate product and engagement concepts with customers and partners; refine problem statements and priorities with evidence.
* Analyze usage, feedback, dependencies, and product performance to find pain points and to drive product improvements.
* Use customer outcomes and quality data to measure results and guide product priorities and investment.
* Explain tradeoffs among customer value, product quality, complexity, and delivery capacity.
* Build and Iterate AI Product Capabilities
* Partner with engineering, design, and AI teams to specify, assess, and deliver Dialog core capabilities.
* Use short delivery cycles; assess readiness, surface risks, and adjust plans as evidence and technical learning evolve.
* Coordinate discovery, launch, and iteration with go-to-market, customer success, support, and operations.
* Track adoption, engagement quality, and customer impact; use results to guide iteration and priorities.
* Deliver with Agility Across Teams
* Adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear decisions, reliable execution, and customer focus.
* Align cross-functional partners on requirements, ownership, dependencies, and sequencing; build shared understanding without direct authority.
* Communicate progress, tradeoffs, and risks; escalate issues that need broader decisions.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree and 5 years of related experience; or Master's degree and 3 years; or PhD and 0 years of related experience, consistent with applicable Cisco hiring guidelines.
* Experience in product management, product development, or product lifecycle management for enterprise software, SaaS, communications, or AI-enabled customer products.
* Experience translating customer problems and business needs into product requirements, prioritized plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Working knowledge of AI-enabled software and a technical discipline relevant to product work with engineering teams.
* Ability to analyze customer feedback, product usage, product dependencies, and quality data to develop prioritization recommendations.
* Ability to collaborate with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners and communicate product rationale, progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.
* Ability to adapt to changing information and priorities, make timely decisions, and deliver effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience taking product concepts from discovery through iterative delivery and assessing results against customer and product measures.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with conversational AI, contact center or customer experience software, and AI engagements that span extended customer interactions.
* Demonstrated ability to perform in a startup or similarly fast-moving product environment, adapting plans as customer needs and product learning evolve.
* Experience with AI-enabled product development, including using AI tools to support product discovery, prototyping, evaluation, or execution.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Product Manager, Toll.OS (Tolling, ITMS and ATMS)_MPIN
job_description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

 **Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

 **Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

**Job Title: Assistant Product Manager**

**About SEEDS**

Sustainable Environment and Ecological Development Society (SEEDS) is a leading non-profit organization working towards making communities resilient to the impact of disaster risks through various innovative approaches, working in disaster management for over 30 years. As you may be aware, SEEDS has been awarded the Sasakawa Award for Disaster Risk Reduction 2022 by the United Nations and the most prestigious Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar 2021 by the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India. It continues to empower the most vulnerable across Asia to build a better future. For more information, visit www.seedsindia.org

Role Purpose

Support the Product Manager in implementing, enhancing and maintaining organizational technology platforms, translating approved business requirements into functional deliverables, coordinating technology development partners, and ensuring effective testing, deployment and user adoption.

Scope of Work

1. **Technology platform implementation:** Support the implementation, enhancement and maintenance of ERP, CRM and other organizational digital platforms.

2. **Requirements and documentation:** Work with the Product Manager and internal stakeholders to gather requirements and prepare functional requirement documents (FRDs), workflows, process maps and technical documentation.

3. **New technology partner onboarding:** Identify and assess prospective technology development partners; coordinate technical discussions, proposal evaluations, scope finalization, contractual processes and project kick-off activities.

4. **Development partner coordination:** Coordinate with existing and new partners on development, testing, deployment, timelines, deliverables and maintenance.

5. **Product development support:** Translate approved BRDs and solution designs into functional requirements, development tasks and implementation plans in coordination with the Product Manager.

6. **Testing and quality assurance:** Coordinate UAT, maintain bug and issue trackers, document feedback and follow up with development partners until resolution.

7. **Process improvement and automation:** Identify operational gaps and recommend technology-driven improvements, including AI-based solutions and workflow automation.

8. **Dashboards and reporting:** Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and automation using Advanced Excel and other digital tools.

9. **Technology research:** Research and evaluate emerging technologies, AI solutions and digital platforms for organizational use.

10. **Training and documentation:** Prepare SOPs, user manuals and training materials, and conduct user training sessions.

11. **Platform monitoring:** Monitor platform performance, track implementation progress, maintain project trackers and recommend continuous improvements.

12. **Cross-functional coordination:** Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to support timely delivery of digital initiatives.

13. **System integration and data management:** Support system integrations, data management and digital transformation initiatives across the organization.

14. **Technical support:** Troubleshoot user issues and coordinate resolution with technology partners.

Pay: ₹781,000.00 - ₹1,030,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

* Challenger Mindset: Continuously question the status quo to drive innovation and improvement.
* Collaboration: Build strong rapport across functions and hierarchies.

o Willingness to travel extensively to connect with sales teams, attend conferences, and meet with stakeholders.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Owner
job_description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Set priorities and outcomes (6‑week cadence)**: align **Product**, **Engineering**, and **Architecture** on **cycle objectives** and measurable OKRs/KPIs (adoption, reliability, security posture, cost/performance). Collaborate with **Security**, **Compliance**, and **Operations** to balance customer value with **security risk**, readiness, and constraints; and bring clear options/trade‑offs to **Planning Day** (scope, dependencies, capacity).
* **Partner with discovery/exploration (intake + feedback loop)**: collaborate with **PM**, **UX**, **Architecture**, and **Security** during **Continuous Exploration (CE)** to clarify the problem, define success metrics, and shape solution options. Align early with **Engineering** and **Operations** on implementation approach, operability, and rollout constraints; and ensure hand‑offs include decisions, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. Feed production learnings back into exploration (usability, risk signals, cost/performance).

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
job_description:
Closing date for applications: 04/12/2026

Location Gurugram, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00288180

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Technical Product Manager - AI Platform

  
  

* You’ll be responsible for managing the development and implementation of technology-driven products
* The role focuses on understanding customer needs, overseeing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful product delivery that aligns with business objectives
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at director level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

  
  

You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and
  
deliver impactful, customer-centric solutions.

  
  

Additionally, you’ll be:

  
  

* Delivering a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements
* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We’re on the lookout for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll have extensive experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with strong leadership abilities, capable of motivating and influencing cross-functional teams.You’ll need at least seventeen years of total experience, with strong expertise in setting product vision, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and aligning development with strategic outcomes.

  
  

You’ll bring extensive experience in designing large-scale cloud architectures and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, along with deep expertise in GenAI platform architecture, agentic systems, cloud-native technologies, and hands-on platform engineering. You’ll also be experienced in creating financial forecasts for products and features, contributing to platform-level budgeting, and driving focus and efficiency through disciplined prioritisation and agile decision-making.

  
  

You’ll also have:

  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and Agile or Scrum methodologies
* Familiarity with software development processes and technologies
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment

**Welcome to our Gurugram hub**
-------------------------------

Spanning 437,000 sq. ft., our campus in Gurugram features two state-of-the-art towers – 1A and 2A at the Candor TechSpace in Sector 21.

### **Key facts:**

* Surrounded by 28 acres
* Space for 4,100 colleagues
* Opened in 2010

job_description:
Position: Senior Product Manager

Location: Mumbai

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Experience Required: 7+ years

**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

the client powers some of India's biggest live event on-sales. As we grow, the consumer app needs one senior owner who ties discovery, buying and retention into a single product. You'll set the direction for the app, lead a team of product managers and ship with design and engineering. Expect high ownership, quick decisions and short paths to users.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO**

App and Discovery

* Own the homepage and app experience, so every visit reflects who the user is and what's next for them
* Build personalised discovery, from playful onboarding to recommendations people act on
* Work with the Shadow lead on how our AI agent fits into the app

Transactions and Growth

* Make the buy flow (event page, seat maps, checkout, referral) faster and more reliable on every device
* Own downloads, retention, engagement and loyalty, with metrics you set and report on

Team & Collaboration

* Lead and grow a team of product managers
* Partner with design, engineering and marketing across Mumbai and Bangalore

**WHAT YOU BRING**

*Specific experience, not vague credentials*

Required

* 7+ years in product, with at least 3 owning a consumer app end to end
* Built consumer apps at scale in India
* Owned a checkout or buy flow where conversion and reliability both mattered
* Moved retention or engagement, and can explain what worked and what didn't
* Managed product managers or APMs

Preferred

* Experience in live events, ticketing, entertainment, travel or a similar consumer category
* Shipped an AI or conversational product to real users

title: Product Manager – Sustainability Data & Analytics
job_description:
ISS-Corporate is seeking an experienced Product Manager, Sustainability Data & Benchmarking Intelligence, to lead the development of sustainability data products for corporate clients. The Product Manager will lead the continued development of our Benchmarking Intelligence products and identify new opportunities to transform ISS STOXX sustainability data, research, and methodologies into actionable client solutions.

The role will have a particular focus on AI-enabled data products and capabilities that help clients access, interpret, and act on complex sustainability data. The Product Manager will work across ISS STOXX to identify datasets, methodologies, and analytical capabilities that can enhance existing products and support new product development.

The Product Manager will own product planning and execution throughout the product lifecycle, including product strategy, client and market discovery, requirements, prioritization, development, launch, and continuous improvement.

**Key Objectives**
==================

The ISS-Corporate sustainability solutions business represents a key area of growth for the company. We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who can:

* Lead the tactical execution, roadmap, and lifecycle of our Sustainability Data and Benchmarking Intelligence products.
* Drive the continued development of Benchmarking Intelligence products that help corporate clients understand their sustainability performance, compare themselves with relevant peers and benchmarks, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Identify opportunities to transform ISS STOXX sustainability data, research, and methodologies into scalable and commercially valuable products.
* Lead the development of AI-enabled products and capabilities built around ISS STOXX sustainability data.
* Identify practical applications for AI, including intelligent search, automated analysis, semantic matching, recommendations, and natural-language interaction with data.
* Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that translate client needs and methodologies into clear specifications for Data and Development teams.
* Define end-to-end client and user workflows, including data access, benchmarking, and AI-enabled interactions, and map them to product features and data requirements.
* Manage the product backlog and participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, prioritizing work to balance client value, commercial impact, and technical feasibility.
* Own project delivery across Research, Data, and Development teams, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks, and communicating progress to stakeholders through release.
* Develop a deep understanding of client needs and workflows and translate complex data and methodologies into intuitive product experiences.
* Gather market and client feedback through consultations, user groups, prototypes, beta programs, and other product discovery activities.
* Work closely with Research, Data, and Development teams to define product requirements and drive execution from concept through launch.
* Support product commercialization and positioning in partnership with Sales, Client Advisory, and Marketing.

**Background Requirements**
===========================

* 5+ years of progressive product management experience, preferably with SaaS, data, analytics, or intelligence products.
* Experience developing data-driven products from concept through launch.
* Experience working with complex datasets and translating data into compelling client-facing products and experiences.
* Experience with, or a strong understanding of, AI, machine learning, or generative AI and their application to data and analytics products is preferred.
* Experience with sustainability, ESG, financial-market data, benchmarking, ratings, or related fields is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, sustainability, environmental science, engineering, data science, or a related field.

**Skills and Personal Attributes**
==================================

* Strong product management skills with the ability to balance client needs, commercial opportunities, technical feasibility, and strategic priorities.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex datasets, methodologies, and analytical models.
* Understanding current and emerging AI technologies and their application to data-intensive products.
* Ability to translate complex data and analytical concepts into intuitive products and compelling client experiences.
* Strong client orientation and an understanding of how companies use sustainability data to support decision-making.
* Strong leadership skills and the ability to drive execution across cross-functional and global teams.
* Excellent problem-solving, prioritization, organizational, and time-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build strong internal and external relationships.
* Self-motivated and able to independently drive initiatives from concept through execution.
* Absolute personal and business integrity and a strong drive to achieve product and company goals.

#LI-DS1

**What You Can Expect from Us**

Our people are the moving force behind our work. We are committed to building a culture that values diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences. If you have the skills, passion, and drive to help us bring clarity and transparency to capital markets, we want to work with you.

Together, we can grow your career in an environment that fuels creativity, drives innovation, and has real impact.

  

**About ISS STOXX**

ISS STOXX delivers world-class research, data, and technology solutions that empower capital market participants to pursue their visions with confidence. Our expertise spans indices, corporate governance, sustainability, cyber risk, and fund intelligence, giving clients the tools they need to uncover opportunities, manage risks, and navigate evolving regulations. We are made up of 4,000 professionals operating across 20 countries and serving approximately 5,000 clients, including many of the world’s leading institutional investors. Our scale and reach give us deep market knowledge, while our innovative methodologies allow us to offer our clients tailored insights that drive impact and success.

As a leading provider of robust data, software solutions and expert advisory, **ISS**‑**Corporate** helps businesses understand and shape the signals they send to institutional investors, regulators, and other key stakeholders. By delivering essential data, tools, and insights, ISS‑Corporate empowers companies worldwide to build resilience, meet evolving market expectations, and proactively manage their governance, compensation, sustainability, and cyber risk initiatives.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Staff Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.

At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

 **Job Description**

As a Senior Staff Product Manager in the ITSM Product team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of enterprise service management. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional thinking, identify disruptive opportunities and redefine how enterprises manage IT services and operations.

You will operate at the intersection of ITSM, ITAM, ITOM and Artificial Intelligence, driving the evolution from traditional ticket-centric service management to intelligent, proactive and autonomous enterprise operations.

We are looking for a product leader who combines deep domain expertise with a strong innovation mindset, someone who can identify emerging customer problems, envision transformative solutions and translate them into differentiated products with significant business impact.

You will work closely with Engineering, AI, Design, GTM and Customer Success teams to take ideas from concept to market, influence strategic product investments and drive meaningful outcomes for customers and the business.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role that requires the ability to think strategically, operate independently and influence across organizational boundaries.

**Impact You Will Create**

**Reimagine the Future of ITSM**

Challenge traditional ITSM paradigms and define the next generation of enterprise service management experiences. Identify opportunities to move beyond reactive ticket management towards proactive, intelligent and autonomous IT operations.

**Drive Disruptive Product Innovation**

Identify whitespace opportunities, emerging customer problems and technology shifts to create differentiated product experiences. Lead 0-to-1 initiatives that have the potential to fundamentally change how enterprises operate.

**Shape AI-Native Product Experiences**

Leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation to rethink existing workflows and create new ways of delivering enterprise services. Explore opportunities for autonomous resolution, contextual intelligence and intelligent orchestration.

**Influence Product Strategy & Business Outcomes**

Translate market opportunities and customer insights into compelling product strategies and roadmaps. Drive initiatives that strengthen competitive differentiation, accelerate adoption and create meaningful business impact.

**Champion Customer-Centric Innovation**

Engage deeply with enterprise customers to understand their operational challenges, validate new concepts and identify unmet needs. Connect customer problems with emerging technology capabilities to develop scalable solutions.

**Elevate Product Thinking**

Bring strong product judgment, strategic thinking and systems-level problem solving to complex product challenges. Influence and inspire cross-functional teams to raise the bar on product innovation and execution.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Define and drive product vision and strategy for disruptive innovation across ITSM, ITAM and ITOM.
* Identify emerging market trends, technology shifts and evolving enterprise needs to uncover new product opportunities.
* Challenge existing assumptions and continuously explore ways to simplify and transform enterprise service management.
* Develop compelling product narratives and strategic investment proposals backed by customer insights and market opportunities.

**Innovation & Product Development**

* Lead 0-to-1 product initiatives, taking ideas from problem discovery and concept validation through product development, launch and adoption.
* Explore how AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation can fundamentally transform traditional ITSM and IT operations workflows.
* Identify opportunities to create entirely new product experiences rather than simply incrementally improving existing capabilities.
* Drive rapid experimentation, prototyping and validation to establish product-market fit.

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Develop a deep understanding of enterprise IT organizations, their operational models, challenges and evolving expectations.
* Engage with strategic customers, industry practitioners and market experts to identify unmet needs and validate product opportunities.
* Build a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, particularly emerging AI-native solutions and established enterprise platforms.
* Translate market and customer insights into differentiated product propositions.

**Cross-functional Leadership & Execution**

* Partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Architecture and GTM teams to translate product vision into execution.
* Influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders to drive alignment on strategic priorities and investment decisions.
* Navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities and drive complex initiatives to successful outcomes.
* Ensure successful product launches by partnering with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on positioning, readiness and adoption.

**Business & Product Impact**

* Own the success of strategic product initiatives, defining clear success metrics and driving measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Balance customer value, market opportunity, technical feasibility and commercial considerations in product decisions.
* Continuously assess product adoption, competitive differentiation and business impact to inform future investments.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

Skills

**Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Strong ability to envision and articulate transformative product strategies and identify opportunities beyond existing product paradigms.
* Demonstrated experience taking ambiguous problems and turning them into compelling product opportunities.
* Ability to think from first principles, challenge conventional approaches and drive 0-to-1 product innovation.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS business models, product-led growth and commercial product strategy.

**Domain & Technology Expertise**

* Deep understanding of ITSM, ITAM, ITOM and enterprise service management ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT operations, service delivery models, workflows and operational challenges.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation and their potential to transform enterprise software.
* Ability to connect emerging technology capabilities with real-world customer problems and scalable product opportunities.

**Execution & Business Acumen**

* Proven ability to drive complex product initiatives from ideation through launch and market adoption.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven product decisions.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to connect product investments to customer value, revenue growth and competitive differentiation.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution excellence.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Exceptional ability to influence and align cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, storytelling and product narrative development skills.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and independently driving high-impact initiatives.
* Ability to inspire teams, challenge existing thinking and raise the bar on product craftsmanship.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive Product Management experience, preferably in enterprise SaaS or enterprise software.
* Deep domain expertise in ITSM, ITAM, ITOM or adjacent enterprise technology domains is essential.
* Proven track record of driving strategic product initiatives and delivering differentiated products with measurable business impact.
* Demonstrated experience taking products or significant capabilities from concept to launch.
* Experience working on AI-driven products, intelligent automation or Agentic AI is a strong plus.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and solving complex enterprise technology problems.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline; MBA is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering and GTM organizations.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

author: Hiring Manager
role: Sr. Staff Product Manager, Product Experience
role_title: Sr. Staff Product Manager, Product Experience
title: Sr. Staff Product Manager, Product Experience
job_description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You’ll Do**

Product experience is how customers engage with Teradata’s platform. This Sr. Staff PM owns a cross-product charter to improve the quality, consistency, speed, and reach of that experience across the customer journeys and shared capabilities that span our products. You will work with the PMs who own individual product surfaces to set their strategy, and you will make the prioritization calls that cut across product lines. You will partner with UX leaders to shape design direction for shared experiences, and with engineering to deliver them.

* Work with PM for each product surface to set experience strategy and keep it consistent across the portfolio.
* Own the roadmap for shared, cross-product capabilities and customer journeys.
* Set priorities across product teams using clear criteria and record the decisions.
* Define and track activation, adoption, time to value, and retention. Run experiments to test what moves them.
* Find where customers drop off between products and get the owning PMs to fix it.
* Work with design, engineering, docs, and field teams on delivery. You decide what to build and why. They decide how.
* Find places where AI can remove steps from customer workflows.
* Partner with UX leaders and engineering to prioritize and fund a shared pattern library. You set adoption goals and settle trade-offs between product teams. They own the patterns and the components.
* Report progress and risks to senior product leadership.

**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate**

* 10+ years in product management, preferably on B2B enterprise data or platform products.
* Experience leading company-wide initiatives across multiple product teams.
* A record of driving adoption and growth with data and experimentation.
* Technical grounding in data platforms and AI.
* Skill at influencing peers and senior leaders without direct authority. Surface PMs keep ownership of their products, so this matters daily.

**What You'll Bring**

* Prior work on products where experience quality set them apart in the market.
* Experience with product-led growth, onboarding, or activation programs.

#LI-PG1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

You will work with the PMs who own individual product surfaces to set their strategy, and you will make the prioritization calls that cut across product lines. You will partner with UX leaders to shape design direction for shared experiences, and with engineering to deliver them.

* Work with PM for each product surface to set experience strategy and keep it consistent across the portfolio.
* Own the roadmap for shared, cross-product capabilities and customer journeys.
* Set priorities across product teams using clear criteria and record the decisions.
* Define and track activation, adoption, time to value, and retention. Run experiments to test what moves them.
* Find where customers drop off between products and get the owning PMs to fix it.
* Work with design, engineering, docs, and field teams on delivery. You decide what to build and why. They decide how.
* Find places where AI can remove steps from customer workflows.
* Partner with UX leaders and engineering to prioritize and fund a shared pattern library. You set adoption goals and settle trade-offs between product teams. They own the patterns and the components.
* Report progress and risks to senior product leadership.

**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate**

* 10+ years in product management, preferably on B2B enterprise data or platform products.
* Experience leading company-wide initiatives across multiple product teams.
* A record of driving adoption and growth with data and experimentation.
* Technical grounding in data platforms and AI.
* Skill at influencing peers and senior leaders without direct authority. Surface PMs keep ownership of their products, so this matters daily.

**What You'll Bring**

* Prior work on products where experience quality set them apart in the market.
* Experience with product-led growth, onboarding, or activation programs.

#LI-PG1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

**Job Title: Product Analyst**

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Level: 12 to 14 Years

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Product Analyst to join our product team in **Hyderabad, India**. The Product Analyst acts as a strategic partner across product, delivery, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure product work is clearly defined, measurable, and successfully adopted. This role is responsible for analyzing current-state processes, identifying gaps, building business cases, supporting change management, maintaining backlog health, coordinating UAT, and establishing control plans that measure release success and monitor operational impacts after implementation. This role is within a fast-paced, highly matrixed enterprise function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with product management, business stakeholders, operations, technology teams, and SMEs to understand objectives, business outcomes, customer impacts, and operational considerations.
* Facilitate working sessions to clarify scope, define problems, align stakeholders, and drive decisions.
* Support backlog prioritization decisions by providing analysis of business value, customer impact, technical dependencies, operational risk, and delivery considerations.
* Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, DSUs, sprint planning, reviews, and demos.
* Partner with Scrum Masters, Architects, Technical Leads, Developers, and QA teams to ensure delivery readiness.
* Answer team questions and provide timely decision-making during development.
* Accept completed stories and features that meet business requirements and Definition of Done.
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI capabilities, automation opportunities, and productivity tools to improve delivery speed, quality, and team effectiveness.
* Partner with operations and support teams to understand release impacts, prepare readiness materials, monitor post-release outcomes, and ensure issues are surfaced quickly.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain strong backlog hygiene by ensuring features and user stories are clear, complete, prioritized, appropriately sized, traceable, and ready for refinement or execution.
* Coordinate UAT planning and execution, including test scope, test scenarios, participant alignment, test data needs, defect triage, sign-off tracking, and business acceptance.
* Provide clear status updates, risks, decisions, open questions, dependencies, and readiness insights to product, delivery, and leadership teams.
* Execute assigned work within priorities and strategic direction established by the APM and/or other APO alignment; independently manage tactical execution while escalating prioritization, scope, and strategic trade-off decisions for alignment.
* Optimize collaboration by using overlapping work hours for decisions, complex discussions, and blocker resolution, enabling productive independent execution outside shared working hours.
* Provide structured asynchronous handoffs that clearly summarize completed and in-progress work, blockers, decisions needed, and actions required from partners to maintain delivery continuity across time zones.
* Maintain delivery management tool with supporting documentation as a current and reliable source of truth, including decisions, refinements, acceptance criteria, test cases, dependencies, and open items, without requiring ongoing follow-up.
* Proactively identify risks and blockers and bring recommended solutions, options, and trade-offs to accelerate decision-making rather than escalating open-ended problems.
* Prepare for, lead, and follow through on stakeholder interactions by providing agendas, documenting decisions and actions, framing trade-offs, adapting communication to the audience, and anticipating stakeholder needs.
* Produce high-quality analysis, release notes, and stakeholder-ready materials with minimal revision or oversight.
