* Pune
* India
* Product Management - Finance/Supplier
* Mid Level
* Remote

  

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

**Why join Coupa?**

* **Pioneering Technology:** At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
* **Collaborative Culture:** We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
* **Global Impact:** Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

**The Impact of Sr Product Manager to Coupa**

Coupa Expenses is a modern expense management solution that helps companies simplify employee spend, from submitting and approving expenses to reimbursing employees and gaining real-time visibility into travel and expense (T&E) activity. By having a fully integrated Mobile and Card solutions, Coupa continually delivers customer value while meeting the evolving needs of our customers.

As the primary product manager on the Coupa Expenses team, you will drive product initiatives that deliver innovation, strengthen adoption, and unblock customers. This role calls for someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds trust across teams, and uses data to inform decisions. You bring a strong bias for action, deep curiosity about how our products work end-to-end, and a genuine desire to make both customers and colleagues successful.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead the Expenses teams product design and requirements across complex, cross-functional initiatives, partnering closely with Engineering, UX, Platform, and Success teams to align on scope, dependencies, and delivery approach.

* Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give internal teams (Product, Growth, Leadership) clear visibility into product adoption, usage, and customer health.

* Act as a go-to subject matter expert for customer escalations, partnering with Support, Services, and Engineering to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

* Translate customer feedback and usage data into clear product requirements and prioritization recommendations.

* Conduct competitive market analysis and continually assess the product's competitive position domestically and internationally.

* Support and help scale internal and external enablement (webinars, documentation, training) so Support, Services, and Customer Success teams can operate more self-sufficiently.

* Represent the product in customer-facing settings, including advisory boards, escalation calls, and adoption reviews.

### **What You Will Bring to Coupa**

* 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments with a proven track record of **building buyer-facing products and consumer-grade UX**

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous requirements through to delivery, coordinating effectively across Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.

* Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience building or using dashboards/reporting tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau) to drive product and business decisions.

* A track record of resolving complex customer issues and turning escalations into durable product or process improvements.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

* A collaborative, "roll up your sleeves" mindset paired with sound judgment on when to lead and when to support.

* Comfort operating with incomplete information and adapting quickly as priorities shift.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in Expense Management, Corporate Cards, or related Finance/Procurement domains.

* Familiarity with SQL and comfort querying data directly to answer product questions.

* Experience working with or presenting to customer advisory boards or executive audiences.

* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or PeopleSoft.

* BA/BS technical degree preferred; MBA is a plus, or equivalent work experience.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:

**Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)**

* **Global Wellness Days:** Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
* **Birthday Time-Off:** Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
* **Volunteer Time Off (VTO):** Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
* **Business Travel Protection:** Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
* **Referral Bonus Program:** Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .

*Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.*

Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.

Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

  

**Benefits & Wellness**
-----------------------

### **Invested in you.**

We help families prepare for the changes in their lives. These benefits include preparing for the birth of a child, adoption, caring for elderly family members, transitioning back to work, and participation in Flexible Spending Accounts.

### **Invested in you.**

We help families prepare for the changes in their lives. These benefits include preparing for the birth of a child, adoption, caring for elderly family members, transitioning back to work, and participation in Flexible Spending Accounts.

### **Well-being head to toe.**

We provide Coupanians with comprehensive healthcare and mental wellness programs.

### **Time off to recharge.**

Generous paid time off including parental leave programs and volunteer time-off.

### **Celebrate your impact.**

We provide a generous 40 hours/year for volunteering and doubled matching contributions to $500 a year.

title: Senior Product Manager - Cogentiq CX
job_description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**About Cogentiq CX**
---------------------

Cogentiq CX is Fractal’s enterprise contact center AI platform, purpose-built for regulated industries such as Banking, Insurance, and Healthcare. It combines voice and chat automation, agent assist, and agentic AI workflows to help enterprises resolve customer interactions faster without compromising compliance, security, or customer trust.

### **The Role**

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and delivery of key capabilities across Cogentiq CX’s voice, chat, and agentic AI stack. You’ll work with engineering, AI/ML, solutions, sales, and customer success to turn customer problems into products that run in production in demanding enterprise contact centers.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for voice and chat automation and agentic AI capabilities
* Translate enterprise customer needs, pilot learnings, and market signals into clear PRDs, user stories, and prioritized backlogs
* Drive design of agentic experiences: orchestration, tool and API integration, guardrails, escalation to human agents, and evaluation frameworks
* Define success metrics (containment, resolution rate, AHT, CSAT, latency, hallucination and compliance rates) and use them to guide iteration
* Partner with engineering and AI teams on architecture trade-offs across ASR/TTS, LLMs, telephony, and CCaaS integrations
* Work with pre-sales, FDEs, and customer success on pilots, POCs, and RFx responses, and carry the learnings back into the product
* Support go-to-market with positioning, demos, sales enablement, and analyst/partner conversations
* Track the competitive landscape (CCaaS vendors, conversational AI platforms, voice AI startups) and sharpen differentiation
* Ensure products meet the security, privacy, and compliance expectations of regulated industries

### **What You Bring**

**Must have**

* 7+ years in product management, with 3+ years on contact center, conversational AI, or CX products
* Hands-on experience shipping voice and/or chat products (IVR modernization, voicebots, chatbots, virtual agents, agent assist)
* Working knowledge of agentic AI: LLM-based agents, tool use, RAG, orchestration, prompt design, and evaluation and guardrails
* Familiarity with the contact center ecosystem: CCaaS platforms (Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Avaya, etc.), telephony/SIP, CRM and ticketing integrations
* Experience with enterprise B2B products, including long sales cycles, pilots-to-production, and complex stakeholder environments

job_description:
**Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns**

**About us:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Guest Experience organization. Target is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.

The **Post Purchase & Returns Product team** is responsible for creating seamless, reliable, and differentiated guest experiences after an order is placed. The team builds capabilities across order tracking, fulfillment, order modifications, payments, returns, and refunds, enabling greater transparency, convenience, and control for guests. Through platform modernization, intelligent automation, and innovative digital experiences, we strive to simplify complex post-purchase journeys, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen guest trust and loyalty.

**About the role:**

This **Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns** role will be based in Target in India (TII) and will serve as a senior individual contributor, driving product strategy and execution for critical capabilities within Target's post-purchase ecosystem in close partnership with leaders and teams across Target.

As Principal Product Manager, you will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for complex post-purchase capabilities, translating guest needs, business priorities, and technology opportunities into scalable solutions. You will drive meaningful improvements in guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes while ensuring products meet enterprise standards for reliability, usability, and scalability.

You will lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple business and technology teams, partnering with senior leaders across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, and Guest Services to align priorities, navigate trade-offs, and remove execution barriers. You will influence decisions across interconnected products and platforms, balancing long-term strategic investments with near-term business needs.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, leveraging guest insights, analytics, experimentation, and competitive intelligence to validate opportunities and inform product decisions. You will establish clear goals and OKRs, assess product health and financial impact, and use data-driven insights to prioritize investments and deliver measurable outcomes.

You will partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to modernize foundational platforms, improve system reliability, and identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify post-purchase experiences and operations.

As a senior individual contributor, you will serve as a product thought leader, influencing product direction across teams, mentoring product managers, and elevating product management practices through expertise, collaboration, and strategic influence rather than direct people management.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of product management experience, including experience leading complex, enterprise-scale digital products.
* Proven experience defining product strategy and roadmaps and driving measurable business outcomes across complex product ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce, retail, order management, fulfillment, or post-purchase experiences, including order tracking, modifications, cancellations, returns, and refunds.
* Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple business and technology teams, navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to build scalable, reliable platforms and modernize legacy technology ecosystems.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to evaluate guest experience, operational efficiency, financial impact, and return on investment to inform product decisions.
* Expertise in product discovery, experimentation, analytics, and data-driven decision-making, with a strong ability to define OKRs and measure product success.
* Strong communication and executive presence, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and driving alignment across large enterprise organizations.
* Expertise in agile product development, including iterative delivery, prioritization, user stories, and working with cross-functional scrum teams.
* Strategic mindset and bias for action, with the ability to balance long-term product vision with near-term execution and business priorities.
* Ability to identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to improve guest experiences and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor product managers, elevate product thinking, and drive strategic influence without formal people management authority.
* Strong ability to build relationships and collaborate across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Guest Services, and Target in India.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

**Company Description**

QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a strategic and technical **Sr. Product Manager** who has built and shipped platform products to lead initiatives across our **Platform** and build a **Marketplace** that powers the broader QAD ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and manage product activities from initial product definition and planning through production, release, and end-of-life.
* Define and execute the product roadmap for QAD's Platform and ecosystem Marketplace.
* Serve as the central resource across design, engineering, process, testing, quality, and marketing teams as products move into production and distribution.
* Own the full product lifecycle, including ongoing modifications, upgrades, and maintenance of the platform and ecosystem capabilities.
* Partner with internal stakeholders, customers, and third-party developers to drive adoption and expand QAD's partner ecosystem.

 **Qualifications**

* Proven experience as a strategic and technical Product Manager with a strong track record of building and shipping scalable platform products.
* Hands-on experience working on integrations, extension frameworks, APIs, or developer/partner marketplaces.
* End-to-end product lifecycle management experience, from discovery and architecture alignment to release, iteration, and maintenance.
* Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, quality, and go-to-market teams.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear customer and ecosystem value.

 **Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set.

**About QAD:**

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr Product Manager - Payments Platform
job_description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

**About the role**

When a contractor in Brazil gets paid on time, a business in Singapore settles in the right currency, or a payroll platform moves money to 40 countries without a single failure: that's what a good payments platform looks like from the outside. From the inside, it's hard decisions about which rails to build on, what reliability means at scale, and how to make a platform handling billions a month behave consistently across markets with completely different rules.

Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Reliability.** Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

* **Corridor and market design**. Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

* **Integration standards.**You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. You decide which integrations are worth doing, weighing partner economics and business impact against build and maintenance cost, and you push the ones that matter through to delivery.

* **Resilience.** Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

* **AI and agentic payment flows**. This is the frontier. Payments infrastructure today is reactive: something breaks, someone fixes it. We want infrastructure that thinks: routes intelligently, detects degradation before customers feel it, reconciles autonomously, resolves failures without human escalation. Nium wants to be the first payments infrastructure company to make agentic flows core to how money moves. You define what that looks like and build it.

### **Requirements**

* Payments experience at real scale: high volume, multi-market, genuine accountability when things break. You understand the mechanics (settlement windows, return codes, reconciliation, failure handling) well enough to bring unambiguous requirements.

* Curious about how payments work across markets. AI-native in how you work. Rigorous about prioritization. Opinionated, not passive: you form a point of view on how a corridor or integration should work, and you push it forward rather than waiting to be told what to build.

* You push Engineering on trade-offs and bring them along with you, holding ground on what's right for the corridor and the business without needing positional authority to do it. And above all, you are passionate about the customer outcome at the end of the transaction, not the platform for its own sake.

* 3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

**The Opportunity**

Most payments PMs work on one market, one rail, one product type. Here you work on all of them simultaneously: Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, MENA, all with different mechanics and failure modes. The exposure you get in two years compresses what usually takes a decade.

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

**How We’ll Measure You**

* Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

* Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

* Integration delivery against committed dates.

* Reduction in payment failures from platform-layer decisions.

**What we offer at Nium**

**We Value Performance:** Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

**We Care for Our Employees:** The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

**We Upskill Ourselves:** We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

**We Celebrate Together:** We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

text:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

**About the role**

When a contractor in Brazil gets paid on time, a business in Singapore settles in the right currency, or a payroll platform moves money to 40 countries without a single failure: that's what a good payments platform looks like from the outside. From the inside, it's hard decisions about which rails to build on, what reliability means at scale, and how to make a platform handling billions a month behave consistently across markets with completely different rules.

Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Reliability.** Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

* **Corridor and market design**. Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

* **Integration standards.**You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. You decide which integrations are worth doing, weighing partner economics and business impact against build and maintenance cost, and you push the ones that matter through to delivery.

* **Resilience.** Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

* **AI and agentic payment flows**. This is the frontier. Payments infrastructure today is reactive: something breaks, someone fixes it. We want infrastructure that thinks: routes intelligently, detects degradation before customers feel it, reconciles autonomously, resolves failures without human escalation. Nium wants to be the first payments infrastructure company to make agentic flows core to how money moves. You define what that looks like and build it.

### **Requirements**

* Payments experience at real scale: high volume, multi-market, genuine accountability when things break. You understand the mechanics (settlement windows, return codes, reconciliation, failure handling) well enough to bring unambiguous requirements.

* Curious about how payments work across markets. AI-native in how you work. Rigorous about prioritization. Opinionated, not passive: you form a point of view on how a corridor or integration should work, and you push it forward rather than waiting to be told what to build.

* You push Engineering on trade-offs and bring them along with you, holding ground on what's right for the corridor and the business without needing positional authority to do it. And above all, you are passionate about the customer outcome at the end of the transaction, not the platform for its own sake.

* 3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

**The Opportunity**

Most payments PMs work on one market, one rail, one product type. Here you work on all of them simultaneously: Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, MENA, all with different mechanics and failure modes. The exposure you get in two years compresses what usually takes a decade.

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

**How We’ll Measure You**

* Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

* Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

* Integration delivery against committed dates.

* Reduction in payment failures from platform-layer decisions.

job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.

Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.

You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.

**What You Will Own**

**Playbooks and the automation engine.** The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.

**Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together.** Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.

**Integrations, actions, and App Central.** Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.

**Agentic and human-in-the-loop response.** Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
* Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
* The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
* Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager
job_description:
The Analytics & AI Delivery Manager for Sourcing is responsible for defining, owning, and executing the end-to-end data, analytics, and AI product delivery for Power’s Sourcing organization. This leadership role ensures that analytical and AI products are delivered on time, within budget, and to high-quality standards while generating measurable business value.
  
  
Serving as a strategic bridge across executive business stakeholders, Digital Technology, analytics operations, AI Foundry, Power teams, the leader will establish the product vision, define complex business and technical requirements, and translate business priorities into scalable, user-centric Analytics and AI solutions. The role will orchestrate cross-functional delivery, drive adoption and integration into day-to-day operations, and continuously improve product performance across the Sourcing domain.
  
  
As the AI Delivery Leader, this individual will oversee overall AI product delivery—from data readiness assessments and Proof-of-Concept execution through MVP delivery, production deployment, and operational transition. By combining deep business-process understanding with strategic roadmap ownership and disciplined delivery oversight, the leader will ensure that data and AI investments remain aligned with operational priorities, customer needs, and evolving market opportunities.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* **AI Data Readiness and Delivery**: Partner with the AI Strategy Data Science and AI Architecture teams to lead data-readiness activities, technical execution of proofs of concept, MVP development, and the scaling of validated solutions into high-impact, production-grade AI products.

* **AI Strategy and Demand Management:** Partner with the AI Strategy Portfolio team to build and maintain a strong demand pipeline, establish effective intake and prioritization processes, and enable a stable, scalable AI delivery model.

* **Data and Analytics Strategy and Lifecycle Ownership**: Partner with Data Architects to define and execute the end-to-end roadmap for data, analytics, and AI products—from ideation and proof of concept through MVP delivery, production deployment, and ongoing product optimization.

* **Partner and Capacity Management:** Translate demand and priorities from the agile planning process into actionable capacity plans. Lead the Program Increment planning process and work with OCIO and strategic partners to onboard the right resources and capabilities for both analytics and AI delivery.

* **Cross-Functional Leadership**: Serve as the primary liaison among executive stakeholders, Digital Technology, business operations, and delivery partners to align requirements, priorities, and execution with strategic business objectives.

* **Operational Excellence:** Drive simplification, standardization, and delivery rigor by facilitating workshops and implementing improvements across tools, processes, and workflows.

* **Requirements and Backlog Management**: Translate complex business needs into well-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs using agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.

* **Data, Risk, and Compliance Governance**: Ensure that all analytics and AI solutions comply with enterprise standards for data quality, architecture, cybersecurity, internal controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

* **Standard Work and Platform Optimization**: Establish robust standard work, simplify complex delivery processes, and continuously optimize analytical platforms and operating models for scalability, reliability, and performance.

* **Performance Monitoring and Value Realization**: Define product KPIs, monitor adoption and user feedback, identify performance trends, and drive continuous product enhancements that deliver measurable business outcomes.

* **Automation and Productivity**: Identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve end-to-end process and data lineage, and partner with enterprise data organizations to increase delivery efficiency and overall team productivity.

  
  

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a STEM-related field, including Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Experience in data management, business intelligence, data analytics, or related discipline.

Technical experience, with demonstrated leadership across multiple functions and disciplines within a product or delivery organization.

Demonstrated success leading at least two significant transformation initiatives, including organizational change management and the delivery of measurable business outcomes.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* **Technical Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience working in Agile and SAFe environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise data and analytics technologies such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, SAP, Oracle, and Databricks. Familiarity with cloud, big data, and AI/ML technologies, including AWS, Python, Spark, and Java, is highly desirable.

* **Business and Domain Expertise:** Strong understanding of Sourcing value streams and the integration of transactional and analytical data to enable actionable insights and measurable business value.

* **AI and Analytics Strategy**: Solid knowledge of data governance, master data management, and the end-to-end AI and machine learning lifecycle, including data readiness, proof-of-concept execution, MVP development, production deployment, and ongoing optimization.

* **Strategic Leadership:** Proven ability to lead transformation, navigate competing priorities, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business leaders.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing teams and collaborate effectively across Digital Technology, Sourcing and other functional organizations to align product strategy with operational priorities.

* **Governance and Risk Management:** Strong commitment to enterprise standards and controls, including cybersecurity, SOX compliance, data governance, privacy, application controls, and regulatory requirements.

* **Process Improvement:** Experience applying Lean principles, structured problem-solving, and continuous-improvement methodologies to simplify processes, establish standard work, and improve the scalability and performance of the product portfolio.

* **Influential Communication:** Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to mentor and energize teams, establish a shared vision, build alignment, and maintain momentum through complex technical and organizational challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, IoT
job_description:
Job Overview
  
The role is responsible for product and solutions planning and execution across India, including assessing customer needs, analyzing market trends, and prioritizing product requirements. It serves as the contextual expert, defining the product vision and providing technical advice and support to the sales team, translating customer needs and expectations into technically feasible solutions, and coordinating product development across R&D and engineering teams.
  
The role works closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery, revenue growth, and high customer satisfaction. This position reports to the Portfolio Sr. Director, Transact.
  
Responsibilities
  

* Engage with customers across India and conduct market research to identify new features and opportunities for product differentiation and innovation.
* Provide pre-sales and post-sale technical support to business and customers, and work with Strategic Account Managers to present technical capabilities and detailed product solutions to customer technical teams.
* Gather customer requirements, help define technical delivery approaches, and support R&D/engineering teams in developing process or system solutions across multiple business domains.
* Define the impact of requirements on upstream and downstream automation and related solution components, hand over tender technical requirements to Service/Projects teams, and liaise with project stakeholders on technical matters.
* Advise business leaders on integrating requirements with existing systems and business processes, review and prioritize value gaps and process improvement opportunities, and support the Service Technical team in improving the technical capability of Service Engineers in the region.
* Identify additional customer needs for consumer experiences within the fuel & convenience retail space and determine delivery approach (build, buy, or partner).
* Create business cases for new products/features.
* Prioritize product backlog and manage the lifecycle of new product features from conception to launch.
* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for IoT retail automation products.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, marketing, and customer support to deliver high-quality products that meet market needs.
* Analyze performance metrics and leverage data-driven insights to drive product improvements.
* Act as a product evangelist, representing the company at industry events, conferences, and with key clients across India.
* Travel to meet with customers, stakeholders, and gather market insights (up to 30% travel).

**Position Relationships:**  
Internal relationships
  
o Engineering
  
o Commercial
  
o Marketing
  
o Customer Success / Customer Support
  
External relationships
  
o Store Retail & Automation Customers
  
o Industry Stakeholders
  
o Partners and Vendors
  
o Conference and Event Attendees
  
Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack
  

* 5+ years of product management experience in the software industry, preferably in convenience and retail fuel sectors, driving product strategies that align with business and sales goals.
* Strong technical background with understanding of software development and web technologies, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams to deliver scalable and customer-centric solutions.
* Fluent English
* Good technical knowledge of IoT, Cloud, Forecourt Control Technologies
* Experience in business development and/or sales, including working closely with sales teams to identify customer needs, develop go-to-market strategies, and support revenue growth initiatives.
* Proven success managing all aspects of a product lifecycle.
* Excellent communication, presentation, leadership, and collaboration skills.
* Strategic and creative problem-solving ability.
* Detail oriented and thorough
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience in retail, convenience, or fuel retail sectors is a plus.
* Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time.

Outcomes and Deliverables
  
Deliverables
  

* Development and execution of a clear, customer-centric product strategy and roadmap for IoT retail automation products in India.
* Solution architecture, product design, specifications, and bill of materials are defined and approved, with compliance to industry standards, safety regulations, and quality control requirements.
* Tender requirements are reviewed across pre-sales and post-sales stages, product fit is identified, sales is supported in shaping tender specifications, and NPD requirements are confirmed where needed.
* Successful delivery of innovative, high-quality product features that differentiate the company in the fuel and convenience retail market
* Product development is coordinated with the product team, prototypes are built and tested, FAT/SAT is completed for the first hardware set, and delivery is achieved on schedule, within quality standards and budget
* Strong alignment and collaboration across cross-functional teams resulting in timely product launches.
* Increased customer satisfaction and market share within the targeted retail sectors.
* Data-driven continuous improvement of product performance and user experience.

Outcomes
  

* Comprehensive market research reports identifying customer needs and market trends.
* Product strategy and detailed roadmap documentation for Transact products.
* Tender Wins
* Correct Product & Solution Selection
* Timely FAT for Project Delivery without any delays
* Prioritized product backlog and feature lifecycle management plans.
* Business cases for new products and feature initiatives.
* Presentations and representation materials for industry events, client meetings, and internal stakeholders.

Competencies
  

* Product Management & Lifecycle Expertise
* Market Research & Customer Engagement
* Strategic Thinking & Roadmap Development
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Leadership
* Data Analysis & Performance Optimization

About Vontier
  
**Vontier (NYSE:** VNT) is a global industrial technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem. Leveraging leading market positions, decades of domain expertise and unparalleled portfolio breadth, Vontier powers the way the world moves – delivering smart, safe and sustainable solutions to our customers and the planet. Vontier has a culture of continuous improvement and innovation worldwide. Additional information about Vontier is available on the Company’s website at www.vontier.com.

title: Associate Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Role: **Associate Technical Product ManagerRole Definitions**Role type: Full-time / PermanentDepartment: Technical Product Management / R&D EngineeringExperience: 2 years in Engineering, Fresher in ManagementJob Location: Kochi, Infopark (On-site)Industry: Telecom/IoT/Electronics/Semiconductor**Role Summary:**As an Associate Technical Product Manager, you will act as the crucial anchor connecting product strategy, engineering delivery, and customer enablement. You will collaborate closely with embedded hardware and firmware engineers, cellular modem specialists, field application engineers, and quality assurance teams.You will own the day-to-day execution of the product backlog for cellular module software/hardware features and platform capabilities. Your primary mission is to translate complex business and technical requirements into well-defined user stories, prioritize deliverables to maximize sprint velocity and quality, and ensure seamless delivery of carrier-grade IoT hardware and software solutions.**Key Responsibilities:**

* Product Backlog & Agile/Scrum Ownership.
* *Serve as the dedicated Product Owner for cross-functional Agile engineering teams (Embedded Firmware, Hardware, and Modem Protocol Stacks).*
* *Own, groom, and maintain a high-quality product backlog; author detailed, unambiguous user stories, technical specifications, and clear acceptance criteria.*
* *Actively lead core Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming/refinement, sprint reviews/demos, and retrospectives.*
* *Collaborate with Engineering Leads to define sprint goals, track team velocity, remove technical impediments, and ensure on-time delivery.*
* Technical Requirements Definition & Lifecycle Management
* *Translate customer needs, market insights, and architectural roadmaps into clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), feature specification sheets, and interface requirements.*
* *Define feature sets and technical requirements for cellular module firmware, AT command sets, SDKs, power management profiles, and protocol stacks .*
* *Work with the engineering team to define seamless cloud-device integration requirements, including eSIM profile switching, remote device telemetry, FOTA (Firmware Over-The-Air) update workflows, and security protocols.*
* *Track product delivery through all developmental phases: Concept, Engineering Validation Test (EVT), Design Validation Test (DVT), Production Validation Test (PVT), and Mass Production (MP).*
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment
* *Interface continuously between R&D (Hardware, Firmware, RF), Testing & QA,*
* *Align feature scope and timelines with global sales, customer support, and product marketing teams.*
* *Support regulatory and carrier certification processes (CE, FCC, PTCRB, GCF, and telecom network operator approvals) by coordinating technical test requirements and compliance deliverables.*
* Quality Assurance, Validation & Continuous Improvement
* *Participate in feature sign-offs, sprint validation, and user acceptance testing (UAT) before production releases.*
* *Monitor bug triage, analyse defect reports, and prioritize critical fixes in upcoming sprints.*
* *Solicit direct feedback from customer deployments, pilot runs, and field telemetry to uncover product enhancements and drive continuous product iteration.*
* Knowledge Transfer & Team Enablement
* *Responsible for technical knowledge transfer (KT), product training, and enablement for customer-interfacing teams, including Sales, Customer Support, and Field Application Engineers (FAE).*
* *Provide documentation, technical guidance, and feature walkthroughs to ensure customer-facing teams effectively support and troubleshoot customer deployments.*

**Required Skills:**

* Technical Knowledge / Skills
* *Solid foundational understanding of cellular IoT and wireless telecommunication standards (5G, 4G LTE, Wi-Fi, BT, NB-IoT, GNSS).*
* *Familiarity with embedded system architectures, microcontroller platforms, and serial communication protocols (UART, USB, SPI, I2C, PCIe, LPDDR, MIPI-DSI, MIPI-CSI).*
* *Understanding of IoT networking protocols (MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, CoAP, TCP/UDP) and AT command interfaces.*
* *Familiarity with eSIM / eUICC technology, FOTA update mechanisms, and cloud-based IoT device management platforms.*
* *Working knowledge of hardware/software release processes, version control, and bug tracking systems.*
* *Demonstrated experience operating in Agile/Scrum frameworks, managing product backlogs, and leading sprint workflows.*
* *Proven track record of translating complex technical concepts into well-structured user stories and product specifications.*
* Core Competencies & Soft Skills
* *Exceptional written and verbal technical communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical architectures clearly to engineering teams and business stakeholders.*
* *Strong analytical mindset with rigorous problem-solving abilities and obsessive attention to detail.*
* *High degree of ownership, self-motivation, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth hardware-software product environment.*
* *Ability to balance technical trade-offs against business value and project delivery schedules.*

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA graduates with a foundational degree in Engineering
* ***Bachelor’s/Master’s degree*** *in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.*
* *Complemented by* ***Master of Business Administration (MBA)*** *in Technology Management / Information Management, Strategy / Strategic Management, Entrepreneurship and Innovation or a related discipline.*

**Professional Experience:**2+ years of hands-on experience as an Engineer (Systems/Embedded, Hardware, RF, etc.) prior to earning an MBA. Fresh MBA graduates with this requisite engineering background

You will collaborate closely with embedded hardware and firmware engineers, cellular modem specialists, field application engineers, and quality assurance teams.You will own the day-to-day execution of the product backlog for cellular module software/hardware features and platform capabilities. Your primary mission is to translate complex business and technical requirements into well-defined user stories, prioritize deliverables to maximize sprint velocity and quality, and ensure seamless delivery of carrier-grade IoT hardware and software solutions.**Key Responsibilities:**

* Product Backlog & Agile/Scrum Ownership.
* *Serve as the dedicated Product Owner for cross-functional Agile engineering teams (Embedded Firmware, Hardware, and Modem Protocol Stacks).*
* *Own, groom, and maintain a high-quality product backlog; author detailed, unambiguous user stories, technical specifications, and clear acceptance criteria.*
* *Actively lead core Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming/refinement, sprint reviews/demos, and retrospectives.*
* *Collaborate with Engineering Leads to define sprint goals, track team velocity, remove technical impediments, and ensure on-time delivery.*
* Technical Requirements Definition & Lifecycle Management
* *Translate customer needs, market insights, and architectural roadmaps into clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), feature specification sheets, and interface requirements.*
* *Define feature sets and technical requirements for cellular module firmware, AT command sets, SDKs, power management profiles, and protocol stacks .*
* *Work with the engineering team to define seamless cloud-device integration requirements, including eSIM profile switching, remote device telemetry, FOTA (Firmware Over-The-Air) update workflows, and security protocols.*
* *Track product delivery through all developmental phases: Concept, Engineering Validation Test (EVT), Design Validation Test (DVT), Production Validation Test (PVT), and Mass Production (MP).*
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment
* *Interface continuously between R&D (Hardware, Firmware, RF), Testing & QA,*
* *Align feature scope and timelines with global sales, customer support, and product marketing teams.*
* *Support regulatory and carrier certification processes (CE, FCC, PTCRB, GCF, and telecom network operator approvals) by coordinating technical test requirements and compliance deliverables.*
* Quality Assurance, Validation & Continuous Improvement
* *Participate in feature sign-offs, sprint validation, and user acceptance testing (UAT) before production releases.*
* *Monitor bug triage, analyse defect reports, and prioritize critical fixes in upcoming sprints.*
* *Solicit direct feedback from customer deployments, pilot runs, and field telemetry to uncover product enhancements and drive continuous product iteration.*
* Knowledge Transfer & Team Enablement
* *Responsible for technical knowledge transfer (KT), product training, and enablement for customer-interfacing teams, including Sales, Customer Support, and Field Application Engineers (FAE).*
* *Provide documentation, technical guidance, and feature walkthroughs to ensure customer-facing teams effectively support and troubleshoot customer deployments.*

**Required Skills:**

* Technical Knowledge / Skills
* *Solid foundational understanding of cellular IoT and wireless telecommunication standards (5G, 4G LTE, Wi-Fi, BT, NB-IoT, GNSS).*
* *Familiarity with embedded system architectures, microcontroller platforms, and serial communication protocols (UART, USB, SPI, I2C, PCIe, LPDDR, MIPI-DSI, MIPI-CSI).*
* *Understanding of IoT networking protocols (MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, CoAP, TCP/UDP) and AT command interfaces.*
* *Familiarity with eSIM / eUICC technology, FOTA update mechanisms, and cloud-based IoT device management platforms.*
* *Working knowledge of hardware/software release processes, version control, and bug tracking systems.*
* *Demonstrated experience operating in Agile/Scrum frameworks, managing product backlogs, and leading sprint workflows.*
* *Proven track record of translating complex technical concepts into well-structured user stories and product specifications.*
* Core Competencies & Soft Skills
* *Exceptional written and verbal technical communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical architectures clearly to engineering teams and business stakeholders.*
* *Strong analytical mindset with rigorous problem-solving abilities and obsessive attention to detail.*
* *High degree of ownership, self-motivation, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth hardware-software product environment.*
* *Ability to balance technical trade-offs against business value and project delivery schedules.*

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA graduates with a foundational degree in Engineering
* ***Bachelor’s/Master’s degree*** *in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.*
* *Complemented by* ***Master of Business Administration (MBA)*** *in Technology Management / Information Management, Strategy / Strategic Management, Entrepreneurship and Innovation or a related discipline.*

**Professional Experience:**2+ years of hands-on experience as an Engineer (Systems/Embedded, Hardware, RF, etc.) prior to earning an MBA. Fresh MBA graduates with this requisite engineering background

Interested candidates please share your resumes to aswathy.r@cavliwireless.com

job_description:
**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates solar, wind, green hydrogen, battery storage, and EV infrastructure projects across the United States, India, and EMEA markets. The company provides turnkey "Development as a Service," powered by 100% internal systems engineering and a world-class team that comes out of some of the most reputed organizations in the renewables industry. This team operates within a sophisticated software and AI environment to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

**Location of Position:**

* Chennai

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead cross-functional teams in defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for our AI-powered digital products at scale. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, applied AI, and renewable energy domain expertise, and will drive the next generation of our internal and market-facing products.

Building on the success of our existing platforms, the AI Product Manager will play a central role in advancing our shift toward agentic, AI-native solutions, translating business objectives and user needs into products that enable smarter automation, faster decision-making, and measurable productivity gains across the organization.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Vision:** Define product goals, multi-quarter roadmaps, and go-to-market plans for AI-powered internal tools and customer-facing products, aligned with business objectives and user needs.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Partner with engineering, data science, legal, sales, and domain experts to guide products from ideation to launch through influence rather than direct authority.
* **Data-Driven Iteration:** Analyze user behavior and market trends, design experiments, and iterate rapidly based on post-launch metrics.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Communicate technical and strategic trade-offs to executive leadership and build consensus across departments.
* **Product Discovery & Prioritization:** Identify high-impact AI use cases across engineering, design, project development, and business teams, and translate them into clear product requirements, user stories, and a prioritized backlog.
* **AI Product Definition:** Shape requirements for agentic applications, copilots, and automations for the renewable energy sector, working with engineering to balance model performance, cost, reliability, and user experience.
* **Adoption & Enablement:** Drive adoption of launched products across the organization through onboarding, training, and user feedback loops, and track measurable productivity gains.
* **Responsible AI & Governance:** Work with engineering and legal teams to ensure products meet standards for evaluation, guardrails, data privacy, and governance.
* **Market & Innovation Insight:** Stay current with advancements in AI, agentic tooling, and the renewable energy software landscape, and translate them into actionable product opportunities for the company.

**Educational and Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, business, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.
* Any additional credentials that reflect an ability to operate out of the box such as having background in finance, operations, strategy will be considered a plus

**Preferred Skills**

**Product Management Proficiency:**

* Proven experience as a Product Manager owning digital or AI/ML-powered products from concept through launch and scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define product vision, build multi-quarter roadmaps, and deliver go-to-market plans.
* Strong working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts (LLMs, RAG, agents, evaluation) sufficient to make informed trade-offs with engineering teams.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, design, legal, and sales through influence rather than direct authority.
* Proficiency in product analytics and experimentation: defining KPIs, running A/B tests, and using tools such as SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Power BI.
* Experience with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.

**Renewable Energy Systems:**

* Understanding of solar energy systems and their integration into existing infrastructure

**Experience**

* Prior experience building products for the renewable energy, power, or infrastructure sectors.
* Familiarity with solar PV concepts, energy modeling, GIS data, or techno-commercial analysis.
* Experience launching AI copilots, chat interfaces, or workflow automation tools for internal or enterprise users.
* Experience with B2B or enterprise SaaS products, including pricing, packaging, and go-to-market.
* Track record of using user research and post-launch metrics to drive product iteration.
* Exposure to MLOps / LLMOps concepts such as model evaluation, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build consensus and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Conditions**

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.

Being an integral part of Cleantech Industry Resources means you can expect to be immersed in a realm of professional possibilities within a culture that nurtures teamwork, adaptability, and the embracing of all.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who is passionate about building digital products which customers love. You will join a dynamic and fast-paced environment and work with cross-functional teams to design, build and roll-out products that deliver the company’s vision and strategy.
  
  
You are currently working on a flexible work arrangement and you are interested to take on more work which can be fulfilling and eventually convert into a rewarding full-time role.
  
  
Absolutely critical is your past experience in managing & understanding the engineering time taken to develop many features and then breaking that into multiple daily sprint batches. We use agile methodology and there are no sprints which last more than 2 weeks with testing time included.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
  
  

* We are looking for someone who can work across the entire product development cycle; customer research, UX discovery, hypothesis definition, wireframing, sprint planning, project management and product marketing.
* 3+ years of experience in software product management
* Creating buy-in for our product vision both internally and with key external partners
* Translating product strategy into simplistic, detailed requirements and prototypes
* Co-ordinate information received between emails, WhatsApp voice messages & calls, competitor platforms, stakeholders of all levels and so much more
* Developer’s Time Management
* Ensure Crystal Clarity in sprint tasks
* Test completed sprints
* Drive a Project Management Platform’s usage
* Traffic Light Sprints in order of business value
* Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth
* Scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact
* Work closely with the engineering team to deliver quick time-to-market by optimizing resources
* Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding across the business to all stakeholders, internal & external

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager
* Well versed with agile software development methodologies
* Some technical background with understanding and/or hands-on experience in software development and web technologies
* Excellent English is very important, written and verbal communication skills
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to think outside the box and roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done

* Flexible time, remote working, 20 hrs per week minimum to be committed
